description.zh: 平方反比引力下，横向发射速度决定轨道：低于圆速度为椭圆，等于为圆，达到 √2 倍圆速度逃逸；能量与角动量守恒给出近远点和等面积定律，T² ∝ a³。牛顿两体模型，数值积分。
description.en: Under an inverse-square pull the sideways launch speed decides the orbit: an ellipse below the circular speed, a circle at it, an escape at √2 times it; conservation of energy and angular momentum give the apsides and the equal-areas law, and T² ∝ a³. A Newtonian two-body model with numerical integration.

label.zh: 平方反比的合力决定运动
label.en: An inverse-square force decides the motion

reason.zh: 牛顿第二定律把 F = GMm/r² 变成加速度 g(r)，再用逐步积分得到轨道；轨道类型只取决于初速度。
reason.en: Newton’s second law turns F = GMm/r² into the acceleration g(r), and step-by-step integration gives the orbit; the type of orbit depends only on the launch speed.

label.zh: 能量守恒给出逃逸速度
label.en: Energy conservation gives the escape speed

reason.zh: 动能加引力势能 −GMm/r 守恒；总能量为 0 时恰好逃逸，由此得到逃逸速度 √(2GM/r)。
reason.en: Kinetic plus gravitational potential energy −GMm/r is conserved; a total energy of zero is the threshold of escape, which gives the escape speed √(2GM/r).

title.zh: 为什么卫星不会掉下来？
